title: Historic Dream • Poolside Retreat
description:
Award winning luxury heritage home in Historic East Nashville.  This 1800’s home has been completely restored, located in Nashville’s most stories neighborhood. 
This 2BR/2BA blends historic charm with modern design. Moroccan rugs, artisan tile, UK cast sinks, and custom cabinetry. Enjoy the plunge pool, patio, and sunbathing area. (hot tub in the winter season)
Front porch overlooks a historic street with skyline views. Walk to the new stadium, dining, and music. 5–7 min uber to Broadway.

The space
2 bed, 2 bath heritage home in Historic Edgefield, plunge pool, front and side patio.

Other things to note
The property has 2 separate private apartments. 
Both with their own private access and parking.
Nothing is shared on the property between the 2 apartments. 
The pool and pool area is for *this listing only. 
There is a privacy fence between both areas making both properties private and hidden from one another.
